lessons.advice: When tracing compound-model separability, check the custom matrix override before following the recursive operator dispatch. Inspect both matrix-operand branches of _cstack when investigating asymmetric nesting behavior.

assumptions.statement: When _calculate_separability_matrix() returns NotImplemented and transform is a CompoundModel, _separable recursively evaluates its children and dispatches their results through _operators[transform.op].

scope.inputs: A CompoundModel whose _calculate_separability_matrix() returns NotImplemented, with an operator present in _operators.

assumptions.workspace_context: Original checkout source as inspected before the agent's source-code edit.

assumptions.statement: For a right operand that is a coordinate ndarray, the inspected _cstack fills the bottom-right block of cright with ones rather than copying right's values.

scope.inputs: Right operand is a two-dimensional coordinate ndarray rather than a Model.

assumptions.workspace_context: Original checkout source before the agent replaced the assignment of 1 with right.

lessons.advice: Inspect build output as well as the shell status when piping a build command through tail. Preserve the build failure status with pipefail before treating a zero return code as evidence of a successful build.
